promotions.title: Release: wishlist and faster checkout
promotions.body:
Promotes staging (#201, #204, #207):
- #201 ABC-11: Wishlist API
- #204 ABC-12: Cache shipping rates at checkout
- #207 ABC-13: Refactor order logging

promotions.title: Release: wishlist screen
promotions.body:
Promotes staging (#85):
- #85 ABC-11: Wishlist screen with a heart button on every product card

linked.title: ABC-11: Wishlist API
linked.body: Adds endpoints to save a product to a wishlist and list saved products. Signed-in customers only.

linked.title: ABC-12: Cache shipping rates at checkout
linked.body: Shipping rates are cached for 10 minutes; the checkout page loads in about half the time.

linked.title: ABC-13: Refactor order logging
linked.body: Internal: moves order logs to the structured logger. No behaviour change.

linked.title: ABC-11: Wishlist screen
linked.body: A heart button on every product card saves it; the new Wishlist tab in the account menu lists saved products.

issues.summary: Customers want to save products for later
issues.description: Several customers asked for a way to keep products they like without adding them to the cart.
The checkout page takes 4-6 seconds to show shipping options.
